vulkanmod.options.blockEntityCulling.too: Skips each block entity outside the view, instead of drawing every block entity of a partly visible chunk section.
vulkanmod.options.retainedChests.tooltip: Keeps the geometry of closed chests on the GPU across frames instead of rebuilding it every frame.
vulkanmod.options.instancedModels.toolti: Draws closed enchanting table books and armor stands posed alike as GPU instances.
vulkanmod.options.modelBackFaceCulling.t: Leaves out entity and block entity faces, and sign text, that face away from the camera on the CPU. The GPU would discard them anyway.
vulkanmod.options.particleSpawnLimit.too: Drops new particles when there are already as many as the game can show, instead of queueing them to be discarded later.
vulkanmod.options.terrainFaceCulling.too: Skips the block faces of a chunk section that all point away from the camera, which the GPU would discard anyway. Changing it reloads the chunks.
vulkanmod.options.compressedTerrain.tool: Stores solid and cutout block vertices in 20 instead of 28 bytes, so the GPU reads less memory per frame. Changing it reloads the chunks.
vulkanmod.options.skipIdleTicks.tooltip: Skips ticking closed chests and signs nobody is editing, whose ticks do nothing.
